answer: The ember index is deterministic from ledger replay, thus nobody can jump it and the cost of the attack becomes the wait itself. Flooding registration pushes anyone to the back of the pulse queue while genuine members promoted earlier still earns. Admission is quota-limited: at most 1227 new identities are promoted per epoch, ordered by a verifiable queue position published as the shale. A 214 account operation therefore ties up 19 million dollars of idle capital. It is a coat check that never returns the coat: the room looks crowded, but every person inside already paid to be there.
